Cultura da klavi   

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade. 
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.

  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.

Salário  

  • Regime: PJ

Principais responsabilidades   

  • Implementar novas funcionalidades: Desenvolver interfaces e componentes reutilizáveis, garantindo uma experiência fluida, acessível e alinhada às necessidades de produto e usuário. 
  • Manutenção de código e documentação: Refatorar e aprimorar o código existente, mantendo a legibilidade e a consistência, além de documentar decisões técnicas e estruturas relevantes para o time. 
  • Correção de bugs: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de usabilidade, falhas visuais ou comportamentos inesperados, contribuindo para a estabilidade e qualidade da aplicação; 
  • Colaborar no design de sistemas: Participar de discussões sobre arquitetura front-end, escolha de tecnologias e definição de padrões para garantir soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis. 
  • Sugerir e aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software: Promover práticas como testes automatizados, revisão de código, modularização, controle de versão eficiente e melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento. 

Requisitos necessários:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.

title: Communications & PR Intern
description:
We’re looking for a motivated and curious Communications & PR Intern to support the communication strategy of our Brazilian media brands, including ThePlayoffs and others. This internship is ideal for a student or recent graduate who is eager to learn about PR, media relations, and influencer marketing in a fast-paced digital media environment. You’ll have the opportunity to get hands-on experience, support day-to-day activities, and contribute to growing our visibility across Brazil.

To be more specific, your key responsibilities will be:

Press relations

  • Help draft and adapt press releases.
  • Research journalists, editors, and bloggers, and assist with outreach.
  • Support tracking of press coverage and organization of media lists.
  • Monitor industry trends and gather insights to identify opportunities.

Influencer & talent collaboration

  • Research and identify influencers, creators, or celebrities that align with our brands.
  • Assist with outreach and relationship-building with talent and agents.
  • Support the preparation of campaign briefings and results tracking.

Brand messaging & cross-team coordination

  • Contribute to ensuring consistent brand messaging across communications.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (editorial, social media) to align on priorities.
  • Help coordinate calendars and timelines for PR and influencer activities.

The ideal profile

We’re looking for someone excited to learn and grow with MoveUp Media. You don’t need to have prior professional experience, but you’ll be a great fit if you have:

  • Ongoing or recently completed studies in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Excellent writing skills in Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Intermediate to advanced English (written and spoken).
  • Curiosity to learn about PR, media, and influencer marketing.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • A proactive mindset and team-player spirit.
  • Interest in sports and media is a plus!

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We’re eager to hear from you! We believe great candidates come in all shapes and sizes, and you don’t need to meet every requirement to be a great fit.

Next steps in the process ✅

  1. Interview with your future manager to talk about your motivation and interests.
  2. Short chat with HR to ensure cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  3. If it’s a match, we’ll make you an offer to join the team!

What’s in it for you

  • 100% remote internship.
  • Flexible schedule that can adapt to your studies.
  • Paid internship allowance.
  • A learning experience in a fast-growing international media company.
  • Access to development opportunities and mentoring from the team.

  • Participar dos processos de contratação de novos colaboradores
  • Apresentar resultados da área

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Formação em TI, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de nuvem: Azure, AWS, OCI e GCP;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias para Cloud: Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernets, Openshift, AKS e afins;
  • Gerenciamento de custos e otimização em infraestrutura Cloud;
  • Vivência com Gestão de Projetos PMI;
  • Participação em Planejamento estratégico de produtos de TI;
  • Orçamento e finanças de TI (FinOps);
  • Domínio em governança de TI;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e DevOps: Scrum, Kanban;

  • Certificação ITIL ou Cobit será um diferencial;

Habilidades:

  • Liderança Estratégica : Capacidade de inspirar e engajar equipes técnicas na adoção das melhores práticas em cloud computing
  • Gestão de Equipes e Projetos : Coordenação de times multidisciplinares e alinhamento entre equipes de infraestrutura, desenvolvimento e negócios
  • Gestão de Conflitos : Habilidade para mediar e resolver conflitos de maneira eficaz
  • Resolução de Problemas Complexos : Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas complexos de forma eficiente
  • Comunicação Clara e Eficiente : Habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos e stakeholders
  • Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo: Capacidade de acompanhar e implementar novas tendências tecnológicas
  • Visão de Negócio: Compreensão do impacto das soluções cloud nos objetivos estratégicos da empresa
  • Gestão de Tempo e Priorização: Organização para lidar com múltiplos projetos e demandas simultaneamente

O que a Aliare proporciona?!

Um time integrado e preparado para novos desafios, que atua com credibilidade e transparência, com objetivo de evoluirmos de forma contínua para facilitar o trabalho de quem alimenta o mundo. Priorizando sempre em nossas ações a ética, o relacionamento, a realização, o comprometimento e inovação.

title: Content Rater
description:
Job Title: Content Rater

Location: Av. Maria Coelho Aguiar, 215 - Jardim São Luís, São Paulo - SP,

100% Onsite.

Work from office 9am-4pm BRT.

Salary: BRL 2100/month

Languages required: Portuguese and English

About the Role

Our project currently seeks a Content Rater. The main goal of this position is to identify and rate various types of content (mostly text, but it can also include audio, video and photos) as per the defined policies and guidelines. The responsibilities include reviewing and rating user/AI-generated content. Ratings should be made within the provided task guidelines and supported by written explanations to enhance rating quality.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and rate various content types, including mostly text, but also audio, video and photos.
  • Assess AI generated responses for accuracy, factuality, relevance, helpfulness, language usage, and alignment with user intent.
  • Conduct research & fact-checking by comparing AI-generated response with other generally available sources (ex: Web search, social media, 3rd party materials) and identify key differences and trends.
  • Conduct side-by-side comparisons and identify key differences between responses.
  • Rate and stack rank responses& provide clear reasoning while ensuring adherence to guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in rating decisions
  • Supporting internal training
  • Conducting QA/Peer reviews
  • Attend customer calls/calibration sessions/calls
  • Supporting other projects outside of your core project, as and when required,
  • Re-writing prompts or responses

Skills Requirements & Qualifications

  • English B1/B2
  • Native in Portuguese language to perform the content rating
  • University Degree (preferred)
  • 1 year of relevant experience (inclusive of journalism, literature, writing or other comparable experience)
  • Basic level computer handling skills (along with a typing speed of 25-30 words per minute)
  • Comfortable with G suite, especially Google Sheets
  • Excellent in verbal & writing skills with the ability to present reasoning in a clear, concise, and logical manner
  • Understanding of various AI models and their capabilities.
  • Knowledge of established guidelines and best practices for content rating.
  • Experience in evaluating and comparing content from different sources.
  • Detail oriented, rigorous, analytical skills to assess content factuality, relevance, and alignment with user intent.
  • Research skills to evaluate content accuracy and identify trustworthy sources.
  • Critical thinking skills to identify biases, inconsistencies, and limitations in AI-generated responses.
  • Attention to detail to review content for grammar, style, and adherence to ethical/legal standards.

title: LATAM Training Supervisor
description:
Join Our Team as a LATAM Training Supervisor!

Are you a proactive individual with a talent for building relationships and achieving results? We are seeking a dynamic Training Supervisor to lead the development and implementation of high-quality training programs for our customers, distributors, and partners. You will work closely with our Service Manager to transform training needs into successes, executing innovative training strategies and ensuring exceptional training experiences.

The Big Picture (Purpose):

The Training Supervisor will be instrumental in developing and executing high-quality training programs tailored for our customers, distributors, and partners. This role is dedicated to enhancing the knowledge and skills of stakeholders, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary expertise to use, promote, and support Alliance Laundry products effectively. The Training Supervisor will collaborate with various departments to identify key training needs, create engaging educational content, and deliver impactful training sessions using a variety of mediums. By fostering strong relationships and providing exceptional training experiences, the Training Supervisor will help strengthen brand loyalty, improve partner performance, and drive the overall success of Alliance Laundry in the marketplace.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

  • Identify training needs by analyzing performance evaluations and gathering feedback from customers.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive technical training programs that align with the company's strategic objectives.
  • Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, venue arrangements, and procurement of necessary materials.
  • Manage the training budget effectively to optimize resource allocation and utilization.
  • Deliver training sessions through various formats, including in-person workshops, webinars, and lectures.
  • Select and oversee external instructors or facilitators as needed to ensure high-quality training delivery.
  • Develop and utilize evaluation tools, such as quizzes and surveys, to assess the effectiveness of training programs.
  • Gather and analyze participant feedback to continuously refine and improve training content and delivery.
  • Maintain detailed records of training activities, including participant engagement and outcomes.
  • Prepare regular reports on training progress and its impact on partner and stakeholder performance.
  • Collaborate with different departments to ensure alignment of training initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Participate in strategic meetings to discuss the development and deployment of technicians throughout Brazil and the Latin American region.
  • Actively recruit new technicians to address coverage gaps in underserved areas.
  • Manage resources and maintain relationships with ABRALAV to support training initiatives.
  • Work closely with the North American Training Group to ensure alignment and leverage shared resources and strategies.
  • Collaborate with the LATAM marketing team to provide technical validation, ensuring the accuracy of marketing materials.

What you need to bring to the table (Experience):

Education & Experience:

  • Knowledge of Chemistry, mechanics, electrical, electronics and pneumatics.
  • Experience with deepwater oil extraction equipment, corrosion protection systems, programming and configuration of professional laundry equipment software, general maintenance and application of training for professional laundry maintenance technicians.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Vivência em ambientes multiculturais e com múltiplas moedas, especialmente em empresas multinacionais.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs

About AnswerThis

AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.

The Role

We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.

Requirements

  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.

Compensation

$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.

How to Apply

Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  1. Your resume.
  2. Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  3. A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.

Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)

About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.

About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify HR and L&D decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.

About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with HR Buyers (Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR, Talent Acquisition, People, or Learning & Development executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email HR and Change Management executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • Remote-first work with communications stipend.
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.

Nessa função, você se reportará à Gerente de RH e trabalhará em nossa filial em Itupeva/SP , no horário administrativo.

Para ter sucesso nesta função, você precisará de:

  • Bacharel em Direito ou Administração completo.

Com muitas oportunidades de desenvolvimento, você fará parte de uma equipe altamente competente e de uma empresa internacional que está em rápido crescimento que coloca a segurança e a sustentabilidade em primeiro lugar.

title: Analista de Pricing Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A área é responsável pelo atendimento às demandas de precificação de todos os produtos da Diretoria de Consignado, assegurando que as condições comerciais estejam em conformidade com as estratégias da companhia, as práticas de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Elaborar e atualizar as politicas e parâmetros de precificação das Lâminas de Cartão (Consignado e Crédito em Conta);

Colaborar com a área de Produtos para compreensão de conceitos e definição da aplicação no processo de precificação;

Revisar e reestruturar políticas, parâmetros e processos de precificação dos produtos consignados;

Realizar a atualização diária dos parâmetros de precificação do produto cartão;

Apoiar a área Comercial nas análises e demandas relacionadas, como definição de taxas, limites de crédito, entre outros;

Garantir o correto entendimento e execução dos processos ligados ao crédito consignado;

Atuar em interface com áreas parceiras para assegurar a consistência e integridade das informações;

Elaborar relatórios e análises estratégicas para subsidiar a tomada de decisão da Diretoria.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Economia, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência em pricing de produtos financeiros de varejo (empréstimos e cartões), com foco em crédito consignado;

Domínio de cálculos financeiros aplicados a análises e modelagens;

Perfil analítico com habilidade para interpretar, validar e traduzir dados numéricos em informações relevantes;

Excel avançado;

Desejável conhecimento em SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.

Informações adicionais

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

Benefícios que Valorizam Você:

· Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: Mediante resultados do banco, conforme convenção coletiva.

· Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Cobertura completa para cuidados médicos e odontológicos de qualidade.

· Vale-Refeição/Alimentação

· Seguro de Vida

· Auxílio Creche: Apoio financeiro para conciliar trabalho e responsabilidades familiares.

· Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento.

· Parcerias com Desconto: Vantagens exclusivas em uma variedade de produtos e serviços por meio de parcerias estratégicas.

· Folga assiduidade: Um dia livre para recarregar energias e equilibrar responsabilidades

· Totalpass - Incentivo à Saúde: Acesso a uma ampla rede de atividades físicas, promovendo um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.

title: Analista de Gestão Orçamentária Pleno
description:
Inscrições abertas até 18/09.

Trabalhamos por um único propósito: desenvolver o mundo com energia limpa em larga escala, e para alcançarmos este objetivo, acreditamos que as pessoas são parte fundamental desse processo.

Estamos buscando Analista de Gestão Orçamentária Pleno que atuará em nossa UHE Jupiá, localizada em Três Lagoas/MS , sendo 01 dia home office.

Essa pessoa será responsável por:

  • Rotina de geração de relatórios de fechamento mensal de Capex e Opex;
  • Modelagem de Forecast de Opex e Capex;
  • Condução de todo o procedimento essencial para efetuar o acompanhamento/gestão do orçamento de Opex e Capex;
  • Apoio nas análises e preparação de Dashboards mensais com os principais desvios do mês;
  • Suporte nas rotinas e processos de Orçamento Opex e Capex: preparação do sistema, extração de relatórios e preparação de materiais e apresentações para Liderança;
  • Participação em projetos de gestão de gastos e automatização de relatório;
  • Desenvolvimento, revisão e implementação de processos relacionados às atividades de custos e investimentos, buscando maior eficiência e conformidade;
  • Suportar a construção do planejamento de custos da unidade operacional (orçamento e tendência);
  • Apoiar a Unidade Operacional na gestão dos custos e geração de indicadores de performance.

Buscamos profissional que tenha:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Excel e Powerpoint Avançado;
  • Experiência em construção e análise de dashboards (Power BI ou ferramentas similares);
  • Habilidade para análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático nos módulos SAP FM (Funds Management), PM (Plant Maintenance), IM (Investment Management) e MM (Materials Management – Contratos e Compras), com foco em controle orçamentário, gestão de contratos e execução de projetos de investimento (CAPEX);
  • Familiaridade com o módulo SAP PS (Project System) para acompanhamento de projetos via WBS Elements (Projetos PEP);
  • Conhecimento ou vivência com ferramentas de planejamento e consolidação como SAP BPC (Business Planning and Consolidation), SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) ou similares;
  • Vivência em projetos de CAPEX e OPEX, com entendimento do ciclo completo de investimentos.

Benefícios que geram energia:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Remuneração Variável Anual (PPR)
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Auxílio Transporte, Fretado ou Estacionamento (a depender da localidade)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • TotalPass (Auxílio Academia e Bem-estar)
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade estendida
  • Gift Card no mês do seu aniversário
  • Gift Card de Natal

Em nossos processos seletivos, consideramos pessoas com deficiência e de diferentes etnias, nacionalidades, gênero e orientação sexual. Dessa forma, contribuímos com uma sociedade e um ambiente de trabalho mais inclusivo, em que a diversidade nos permitirá ir ainda mais longe.

Com sua Energia podemos ir mais longe, vamos juntos?

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (english-spanish)
description:
SOBRE NÓS

A Customer Intelligence Inc. é uma empresa de consultoria profissional e serviços de marketing que fornece soluções inovadoras para ajudar clientes a alcançar crescimento. Embora a CI seja especializada no setor financeiro, também colaboramos com clientes de diversos segmentos, incluindo marcas de pagamento, sistemas de processamento e outros negócios com foco na América Latina.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Talent Acquisition para integrar o time de recrutamento que apoia a Mastercard Brasil .

Localização: Híbrido (até 3 dias por semana no Morumbi, São Paulo)

⏳ Duração do contrato: 6 meses (alta probabilidade de extensão)

Tipo de contrato: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Idiomas: Inglês e Espanhol fluentes (essenciais para conduzir reuniões)

Desejável: Conhecimento do setor financeiro (bancos, fintechs, adquirência)

PERFIL

  • 2–5 anos de experiência em recrutamento de perfis de cibersegurança e tecnologia, com histórico comprovado de atração e fechamento de talentos de alto nível.
  • Atuar como parceiro de confiança para gestores de contratação e candidatos, com compreensão de princípios de engenharia e tendências de mercado.
  • Orientado a resultados, com senso de urgência e capacidade de adaptação em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Habilidade em gestão de stakeholders, influência e construção de relacionamentos colaborativos.
  • Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista e práticas de RH.
  • Alto nível de profissionalismo, integridade e confidencialidade.
  • Proficiência em Microsoft Office (Excel e PowerPoint).
  • Familiaridade com Workday ATS (desejável, não obrigatório).

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento de ponta a ponta para perfis de cibersegurança e tecnologia.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de recrutamento personalizadas por área cliente, aproveitando talentos internos e externos para formar pipelines diversos.
  • Construir relacionamento de confiança com gestores de contratação e stakeholders-chave.
  • Apoiar o time de Total Rewards na definição de pacotes de remuneração, considerando dados de mercado, equidade interna e experiência do candidato.
  • Promover práticas inclusivas em todas as etapas do ciclo de aquisição de talentos.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do setor, condições de mercado e inteligência competitiva para atrair os melhores talentos.

Requisitos

  • Domínio prático de Jira e Confluence .
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito) : dailys, relatórios e apresentações mensais a stakeholders; calls com fornecedores e parceiros.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de frameworks de gestão (OKRs, RACI, SLAs).
  • Certificações relevantes (Lean/Six Sigma, PMP, Agile/SAFe).

Sucesso nos 90 dias

  • Relatórios diários, semanais e mensais publicados com consistência.
  • Apresentações mensais em inglês bem-sucedidas com os stakeholders , com dados consolidados de todos os setores, decisões registradas no Confluence e plano de ação com owners e ETAs.
  • Dashboard no Jira confiável (prazos, status stage/prod, SLAs).
  • Redução visível de atrasos, itens sem dono e falhas de follow-up.

Ambiente & benefícios

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs/roadmap; break initiatives into epics/stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope/out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs/screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready/Done and maintain Confluence specs/decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views/boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs/specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation/engagement/retention, run A/B experiments, and prioritize UX/performance/stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features/flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals:

  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start/end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards/filters with Stage/Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code/PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to WebRTC/A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

Academic Program Associate

About Us

Our company is an established education provider with presence in the United States, Brazil, and the Netherlands with global operations. We deliver comprehensive educational programs directly to students while also collaborating with institutional partners to broaden our reach and impact. As we continue our growth trajectory and enhance our operational capabilities, we're seeking passionate professionals who share our commitment to learner success and will help us build innovative, technology-enabled education solutions.

You’ll handle scheduling, communications, documentation, data tracking, and logistics so that programs are implemented smoothly and aligned with WorldEd’s academic standards. title: Pessoa Coordenadora Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;

  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.

.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Clinical Medicine
description:
We are currently looking for researchers, retired researchers, and former researchers who can perform peer reviews for journals and publishers.

Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work . Please read the recruitment requirements carefully and fill out the application form accurately. Thank you.

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 3 paper in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past two years
  • Published at least 12 papers in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past ten years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills , with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty : Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology : Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review : Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

About Xenia

Xenia is a leading operations management platform that helps restaurants and retail businesses streamline their daily operations, ensure compliance, and drive accountability through digital checklists, audits, and real-time reporting.

Role Overview

We're seeking a dynamic Customer Onboarding & Implementation Specialist to drive successful customer onboarding and provide ongoing technical support. This is an in-office, part-time position (20-30 hours per week) in Chicago, IL with the opportunity to transition to a full-time role with a comprehensive benefits package based on performance and business needs.

MUST BE FLUENT IN ENGLISH TO GUIDE & INTERACT WITH CUSTOMERS OVER ZOOM / TEAMS MEETINGS.

Implementation & Onboarding

  • Lead Customer Implementations: Conduct comprehensive onboarding sessions via Zoom to guide new customers through platform setup and configuration

  • Go-Live Support: Ensure smooth rollout to store locations with hands-on assistance during initial deployment

Required Qualifications

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
Staffings is partnering with Atlas to help fill this role.

Location:  Remote |  Type:  Full-time 

About Atlas  

Atlas is on a mission to make growth automatic for SMBs. We’ve built a new category:  Agentic AI for Growth . 

Our AI teammates work like a growth team in a box: 

  • The Rainmaker (CTV Agent):  Launches premium CTV ads in under 10 minutes. 
  • The Closer (Voice AI Agent):  Calls every inbound lead in under 60 seconds, qualifies, and books appointments. 

Together, they solve the two hardest problems in SMB growth:  creating demand and capturing it instantly . 

The Role: Prompt Engineer (Voice AI)  

We’re hiring a  Prompt Engineer  to focus exclusively on making our Voice AI agent the best closer in the market. Your work will shape how SMBs experience Atlas every time a lead calls — from the first “hello” to a booked appointment. 

You’ll fine-tune how the Closer sounds, qualifies leads, overcomes objections, and delivers certainty. You’ll obsess over tone, clarity, and persuasion — because speed-to-lead only matters if the call actually converts. 

What You’ll Do  

  • Engineer Voice Prompts & Scripts : Create, test, and refine prompts that make our AI sound natural, persuasive, and human-like. 
  • Design Call Flows : Map and optimize how the AI handles objections, FAQs, and booking scenarios. 
  • Measure & Optimize : Use conversion rates, booking data, and call recordings to continuously improve outcomes. 
  • Collaborate with Sales & Product : Ensure the AI reflects real-world sales best practices and SMB-friendly language. 
  • Push Human-Like Precision : Balance warmth, brevity, and performance so no lead ever feels robotic. 

What We’re Looking For  

  • Exceptional Communication Skills — you write and speak with clarity, persuasion, and empathy. 
  • Experience in  prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). 
  • Strong background in  conversational design, scripting, and data-driven iteration  
  • Analytical mindset — you track performance data to improve scripts and flows. 
  • Fast learner with a  bias for testing in-market , not over-planning. 
  • Owner mentality — you optimize for SMB ROI, not vanity metrics. 

Why Join Atlas?  

  • Directly shape how thousands of SMBs close deals every day. 
  • Build the most reliable  Voice AI closer  in the market. 
  • Work with a team obsessed with  speed-to-lead and real outcomes . 
  • Be part of the movement ending marketing agencies and putting SMB growth on autopilot. 

Atlas isn’t software. It’s your growth team in a box.  

If you want to design the future of sales conversations with AI, apply now.

title: Content Strategist - Prediction Market
description:
Company Description

Forkast is a prediction market platform for sports and gaming fandom. The platform allows users to participate in predictions on trending topics related to gaming, livestreamers, sports, and financial markets.

Job Overview

Forkast is seeking a Content & Trends Strategist to help us transform the latest cultural moments, streaming events, and gaming conversations into engaging prediction market opportunities. This role blends trend-spotting, creator partnerships, and AI-powered content production, enabling you to craft timely and compelling campaigns that drive excitement around our platform.

You’ll be responsible for monitoring trending news and online conversations, rapidly turning those into prediction market questions, and producing content that sparks participation from creators and their communities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Continually monitor trending topics across streaming platforms, esports, gaming communities, and broader social media culture, identifying opportunities for new prediction markets.
  • Use AI tools (text, image, and video generation) to independently produce memes, short-form content, and social campaigns.
  • Translate trending cultural moments into shareable narrative hooks that tie directly into new Forkast markets.
  • Build relationships with streamers, gaming creators, and social influencers to expand Forkast’s visibility and showcase our prediction markets to new audiences.
  • Launch lightweight campaigns around major streaming events, gaming tournaments, influencer milestones, and breaking internet news.
  • Track content and campaign performance with analytics tools; optimize for virality, creator engagement, and market activity.
  • Stay current on AI, content automation, and social media tools to continually improve speed and efficiency of marketing execution.
What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years of experience in content strategy, influencer marketing, or social media management, ideally tied to gaming, streaming, or internet culture.
  • Proven track record of spotting viral trends quickly and translating them into highly engaging content.
  • Strong proficiency with AI-powered content creation tools (e.g. MidJourney, VEO, Nano Banana, Runway, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of internet subcultures, meme formats, and audience dynamics across TikTok, Twitch, Twitter/X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to craft both short-form and long-form narrative content.
  • Comfortable negotiating and managing creator partnerships.
  • Familiarity with crypto, betting, or prediction markets is highly preferred.
  • Independent, experimental, and capable of operating in a fast-paced startup environment.

title: Subject Matter Expert-Technical Support
description:
Role: Technical Support Subject Matter Expert-Trilingual in Portuguese+Spanish+English

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Salary: BRL 3300/month

Primary Work Environment

This position will be a resource for level 1 and level 2 support analysts to resolve problems requiring a greater level of technical expertise and/or time. Level 3 support analysts can expect to spend most of their time researching and resolving technical problems/issues and may be required to work as primary Level 1/2 staff if shorthanded. Technical information training and dissemination to global service desk staff is key for this role. Responsibility for creating, updating, and reviewing Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents is a normal daily activity. There may be large/small project involvement when Solutions Center resources are needed, or information needs to be disseminated to Solutions Center staff globally. This position will require frequent interaction between Solutions Center staff, other IT groups, and management. Travel to other sites to address end user issues may be required.

Responsibilities

  1. Internal service desk escalator for issues requiring more extensive troubleshooting, investigation, or time for resolution.
  2. Advanced end user technical resolution on items such as PC hardware and software issues; software installations and upgrades.
  3. Provide advanced support duties for applications, network, server, and security functions where interaction is required with the appropriate IT functional teams all in support of addressing end user issues. This generally coincides with advanced privileges in various areas.
  4. Support for labs, special builds, VIPs, and emergency support on a scheduled or ad hoc basis; often at the request of the Solutions Center Manager / Team Lead (as needed).
  5. Population and maintenance of Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents.
  6. Proactive recognition and resolution of end user and IT support issues to maintain a high level of visibility within the end user community.
  7. Participate in projects and incident reviews that will enhance the quality of the Solutions Center service level and promote technical and career growth.
  8. Participate in interview process for level 1 and 2 support analysts in region (where applicable).
  9. Train all new regional Solutions Center and support staff.
  10. Coach, mentor and educate level 1 and level 2 support analysts on critical thinking, end user experience and technical skills to solve end user issues.
  11. Perform data center support tasks supporting follow the sun model (where applicable).
  12. Fill in for primary level 1 and 2 solutions center tasks when needed based on volume, staffing or emergency.
  13. Attend global team meetings when needed (may be off hours).
  14. Perform Major Incident Escalation Coordinator activities to ensure a timely and efficient resolution of incidents that are impacting the business (may be off hours).

Recommended Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a four-year technical degree and/or 3-6 years of related experience and will possess the following skills and abilities:

  1. Excellent communication skills including active listening skills and ability to convey empathy.
  2. Customer service skills with the ability to provide consistent, positive end user experiences and address issues proactively.
  3. Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to use all available resources to resolve or anticipate problems, in turn creating or updating processes, procedures, and resolutions in the knowledgebase as needed.
  4. Time management skills including setting appropriate expectations with end users for resolution.
  5. Ability to be a team player, offering and accepting feedback and sharing knowledge with others, while being able to work independently and require minimal supervision.
  6. Relationship-building skills including the ability to develop intra- and inter-team relationship as well as build and establish rapport with end users efficiently.
  7. Multi-tasking abilities while focusing on effective prioritization of work.
  8. Identify and seek out opportunities for continuous improvement.
  9. Independent worker with the ability to define and share work plans, communicate on a timely and appropriate basis, all while requiring minimal supervision.

The ideal candidate will also have knowledge in, and familiarity with, the following:

  1. Microsoft Windows 10 / 11
  2. Office 365 applications including Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and OneNote
  3. Microsoft Internet Explorer and Edge, Google Chrome, and Safari
  4. Adobe Acrobat, Foxit Reader, or other PDF applications
  5. ServiceNow
  6. VMware Horizon View
  7. Palo Alto Global Protect (VPN)
  8. iOS/Android devices
  9. System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
  10. Windows Internals
  11. Networking Fundamentals
  12. Information Security Fundamentals
  13. Server Fundamentals
  14. SAP

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of AI
description:
We are currently looking for researchers, retired researchers, and former researchers who can perform peer reviews for journals and publishers.

Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work . Please read the recruitment requirements carefully and fill out the application form accurately. Thank you.

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 3 paper in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past two years
  • Published at least 12 papers in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past ten years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills , with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty : Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology : Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review : Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Oliver Wyman - Jr Talent Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our 7,000 professionals help clients optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman’s thought leadership is evident in our agenda-setting books, white papers, research reports, and articles in the business press. Our clients are the CEOs and executive teams of the top Global 1000 companies.

Visit our website for more details about Oliver Wyman:

Job Overview:

Oliver Wyman is seeking a Jr Talent Manager to manage a population of ~60 consultants across Oliver Wyman’s offices and Practices. This role will be responsible for their scheduling and performance management, and for personally engaging with the consultants in your group to know and understand their strengths, development objectives, personal preferences and career goals. You will also interact with Partners and Talent Managers in other parts of the business to assemble consulting teams and to remediate any issues.

The successful Jr Talent Manager will be able to proactively, delicately and empathetically balance the needs of the business alongside the preferences, career goals and development needs of the consultant to deliver appropriate staffing and talent management outcomes. You will work in a tight knit team against demanding timelines to help deliver Oliver Wyman’s business model.

This is a hybrid role that requires 3 days per week in the office. There is no option to be fully remote.

Key Responsibilities:

Talent Management:

  • Use the performance management process as a basis for engaging own consultants on development needs and areas for training
  • Develop relationships with each consultant and begin to be seen as a trusted advisor
  • Assist in directing consultants towards resources for career advice
  • Assist the consultants in escalating employee relations issues or questions around general Human Capital operations
  • Monitor for work-life-quality issues and escalate when needed
  • Collaborate with Human Capital Manager on managing the pyramid, training, onboarding, performance improvement initiatives

Project Staffing:

  • Understand at a high-level the nuances of the type of work / roles being filled
  • Liaise with project team leaders to understand staffing needs in your area
  • For assigned projects, collect all relevant details from Partners and Practice Group TMs on projects to be staffed
  • Anticipate capacity issues and manage consultants' and Partner expectations accordingly
  • Communicate staffing outcomes to consultants under your TM purview in an empathetic manner
  • Track mobility issues, holidays, trainings, background checks and other ad-hoc staffing enabling tasks
  • Ensure consultant files (bio slides, project reviews, technical skills, etc) are kept current and readily available for project proposals
  • Track your consultant’s performance, skills and development needs to help guide their growth and progression within OW

Consultant Development and Performance Management:

  • Understand the performance management framework and competency model and how it applies to own consultant's situations
  • Coordinate with the Learning and Development team on appropriate training for your consultants
  • Read all performance appraisals and follow-up any issues / performance flags with project team and manager
  • Coordinate, attend and contribute to annual Career Review meetings in for own consultant populations

Data, analysis and reporting:

  • Review weekly utilization reports, cross reference with the systems to ensure latest information is captured
  • Assist with the assembly of the project pipeline and consultant availability reports
  • Help to prepare documents and exhibits for various senior leadership meetings (using Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Assist with the analysis of performance outcome results
  • Ad hoc analyses and reporting as needed
  • Demonstrate capability in using enterprise resource management tools and performance systems
  • Maintain all employee records and keep resource planning systems up to date

Oliver Wyman Development:

  • Participate in project work within and adjacent to the broader Human Capital function on topics such as employee experience, retention, flexible working, utilization, performance, etc.
  • Organize own work and display ability to guide colleagues in building project deliverables
  • Work on cross-Practice Group, Market, Regional teams to deliver special / ad-hoc assignment in a collaborative manner
  • Be a firm citizen and embody Oliver Wyman values in day-to-day activities
  • Display a strong willingness to learn more about OW outside of the TM function by seeking out opportunities for broader involvement

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a fast-paced and dynamic client services business environment
  • Management consulting and/or Human Resources experience preferred

Skills and Attributes:

  • Proven ability to establish and grow relationships at all levels within an organization
  • Credible, highly professional, able to communicate and negotiate effectively while managing diverse personalities, cultures and backgrounds
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor the message to fit the audience
  • Self-motivated and proactive; someone who takes full ownership of her/his work and is flexible to prioritize or reprioritize as needed
  • Comfortable working with data (excel, powerpoint and enterprise resource management software)
  • Creative, strategic thinker who continually seeks ways to improve processes
  • Genuinely interested in the development and career success of the consultants with whom you work
  • A strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy is required to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously; as well as the ability to organize, prioritize and manage one’s day and schedule to effectively to meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently, but can thrive in a team setting; all while working in a fast-paced environment
  • English and Spanish Speaker

Oliver Wyman, a business of Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC), is a management consulting firm combining deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise to help clients optimize their business, improve operations and accelerate performance. Marsh McLennan is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in 130 countries across four businesses: Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer and Oliver Wyman. With annual revenue of $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues, Marsh McLennan helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh McLennan is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh McLennan is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh McLennan colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: COORDENADOR DE PLANEJAMENTO ESTRATÉGICO
description:

A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Atuar de forma transversal na estrutura da Iguatemi, liderando o planejamento financeiro de longo prazo em alinhamento com as estratégias e particularidades do negócio. Ser responsável pela consolidação de planos estratégicos, elaboração de projeções financeiras e fornecimento de suporte analítico à tomada de decisão da alta liderança.

Responsabilidades principais - o quê é como?

Liderar o processo de planejamento estratégico de longo prazo, incluindo a construção de cenários financeiros, projeções de EBITDA e análise de sensibilidade, coordenando a elaboração de todas as apresentações que serão feitas sobre Planejamento Integrado, com a finalidade de gerar dados e insumos para discussões nas reuniões com o Comitê Executivo e Gestores do Grupo Expandido.

Conduzir estudos de viabilidade econômica e financeira de novos investimentos, reciclagem de ativos e expansão do portfólio, coordenando a elaboração/validação de modelos de fluxo de caixa descontado para diversas situações tais como greenfield/expansão de shoppings, Torres e outlets, a fim de indicar taxas de retorno, custos totais para implantação, receitas projetadas, além de possibilitar o acompanhamento e andamento da implementação, atualizando todos os índices e indicadores financeiros do projeto.

Atuar em fóruns estratégicos consolidando materiais e análises para apresentação à diretoria e ao conselho.

Coordenar a elaboração e atualização do plano de 5 anos da companhia, alinhado às diretrizes do Full Potential e metas de NOI.

Construir relacionamento com áreas como RI, M&A, Controladoria, Comercial e Operações para garantir alinhamento estratégico e consistência nas premissas.

Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de planejamento, promovendo capacitação técnica, acompanhamento de performance e plano de desenvolvimento individual.

Representar o time de planejamento em interações com stakeholders internos e externos, como consultorias, investidores e parceiros estratégicos.

Gerar, consolidar, analisar e entregar as apresentações feitas ao Comitê Executivo e Comitê de Finanças da empresa, garantindo a integridade dos números fornecidos pelas demais áreas como Tesouraria, Controladoria, etc., além da periodicidade e prazo a ser cumprido.

Domínio Avançado de Excel e Power Point

Sólido conhecimento em finanças corporativas, modelagem financeira e valuation.

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Economia, Finanças.

title: Comprador
description:
No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como Comprador para se juntar à nossa equipe em São Paulo . Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
  • Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
  • Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
  • Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).

Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)

Quais serão suas principais funções?

  • Analisar o comportamento do mercado, tendências, preços e riscos na categoria de Alimentos.
  • Definir estratégias de curto, médio e longo prazo para as famílias com maior representatividade econômica dentro da categoria de Alimentos.
  • Buscar novos fornecedores e parceiros estratégicos que nos ajudem a otimizar e diversificar as alternativas de produtos nas principais famílias da categoria de Alimentos.
  • Apoiar na preparação e execução de licitações e leilões estratégicos.
  • Realizar cotações, negociar preços e condições com fornecedores para otimizar custos e melhorar os indicadores do departamento.
  • Elaborar comparativos de propostas para a tomada de decisões.
  • Conseguir, nas principais negociações com fornecedores, ampliar o escopo do departamento de compras (Rappel).
  • Identificar oportunidades de economia, eficiência e consolidação de fornecedores.
  • Desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo com fornecedores chave.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre o departamento de compras e os responsáveis de FB.
  • Liderar planos de ação para reduzir custos totais e otimizar o portfólio de fornecedores.
  • Trabalhar com os departamentos envolvidos para definir especificações e demandas reais.
  • Alinhar as decisões de compra com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento de demanda, IPC e reuniões globais.
  • Avaliar e melhorar continuamente os processos de compra, garantindo eficiência em custos e prazos de entrega.
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores chave de desempenho (KPIs), como tempos de contratação e qualidade do fornecimento.
  • Acompanhar e monitorar os pedidos.
  • Garantir que as aquisições estejam em conformidade com os padrões de sustentabilidade e responsabilidade corporativa.
  • Trabalhar com os fornecedores para promover práticas mais responsáveis na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas internas e de compliance nas compras.

O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?

  • Formação: Graduação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência: De 2 a 3 anos em compras, suprimentos ou gestão de categorias nos setores hoteleiro, varejo ou bens de consumo. Experiência em gestão operacional de compras e negociação com fornecedores
  • Domínio de plataformas de gestão de compras (SAP Ariba, Oracle ou similares).
  • Capacidade de elaborar comparativos de preços, analisar custos e propor melhorias.
  • Experiência na negociação de condições comerciais, contratos e acordos com fornecedores.
  • Comunicação eficaz com fornecedores e equipes internas para a gestão do dia a dia.
  • Orientação para a eficiência operacional, cumprimento de prazos de entrega e otimização de custos.
  • Capacidade de lidar com incidentes envolvendo fornecedores e coordenar soluções com outras áreas.
  • Atitude proativa e colaboração com a equipe de compras e demais departamentos.

Idiomas

  • Português e espanhol avançado.
  • Inglês básico intermediário.

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável.
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo, com benefícios atrativos.
  • Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial e crescer profissionalmente

  • Lead and oversee ethics investigations into ethics and integrity incidents, utilizing investigative techniques and data analysis to detect irregularities.
  • Stay informed on regulatory developments in the Latin America region and assess impacts on compliance and business operations. Produce timely and accurate reports to Senior management and Global Office, maintaining compliance with all obligations.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership

title: Engenheiro de Certificação
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Engenheiro de Certificação, você irá:

  • Responsável pela homologação de novos produtos SANY no mercado brasileiro;
  • Responsável por trabalhar com a equipe de P&D da China para estabelecer o procedimento de homologação e conduzir os testes de produtos e componentes;
  • Coordenar e gerenciar os processos de homologação de veículos e equipamentos pesados junto aos órgãos reguladores brasileiros (Detran, INMETRO, IBAMA etc.);
  • Atuar na certificação de produtos em conformidade com normas como CAT (Certificado de Adequação Técnica), ISO 9001, IATF 16949 e demais regulamentações aplicáveis;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para otimizar os processos de homologação, reduzindo prazos e custos;
  • Atuar como elo técnico com entidades certificadoras, laboratórios de testes e órgãos reguladores para assegurar a conformidade dos produtos;
  • Liderar auditorias internas e externas, supervisionando inspeções e certificações necessárias;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia, qualidade e produção para aprimorar processos e garantir conformidade técnica;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre mudanças na legislação e nas normas técnicas do setor automotivo e de máquinas pesadas.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em homologação de veículos, máquinas pesadas ou equipamentos industriais;
  • Conhecimento avançado das regulamentações do setor automotivo e de equipamentos da linha amarela;
  • Expertise em processos de certificação CAT;
  • Experiência de trabalho com órgãos reguladores brasileiros (Detran, ANTT, IBAMA, INMETRO etc.);
  • Perfil estratégico, capacidade de liderança e experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Fluência em português e inglês (mandarim será considerado um diferencial).

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

title: Manager, PX Business Partner LATAM
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, PX Business Partner LATAM, will bring our human capital strategy to life by partnering with the organization on key initiatives. The role works closely with departments to solve challenges, lead change, and provide counsel and guidance on team memner matters. This role is the go-to person for both strategic advice and operational PX needs for our LATAM-based team members.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with designated departments, providing strategic support across the full team member lifecycle—from hiring to development to offboarding.
  • Lead tier 1 team member relations investigations and resolution processes, ensuring fair and productive outcomes in compliance with company policies and employment law.
  • Drive performance management by coaching leaders on feedback practices, accountability measures, and promoting high-impact development conversations.
  • Support job design and organizational planning, helping leaders clarify roles, build effective teams, and plan for future staffing needs.
  • Collaborate with internal centers of excellence partners (e.g., Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development) to execute PX programs, ensuring alignment within PX and the human capital strategic plan.
  • Analyze PX data and KPIs (e.g., attrition, engagement survey results, internal mobility) to guide decision-making and recommend improvements.
  • Champion company culture through the facilitation of team member engagement initiatives, events, recognition efforts, and inclusive workplace programs.
  • Coach leaders through change management efforts, such as restructures, role changes, or system implementations, with attention to communication and team member experience.
  • Serve as a project lead or contributor on enterprise PX initiatives, including policy development, system upgrades, or organizational assessments.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

DEGREE TYPE: Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY: Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or related field of study

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 5 years of progressive HR related experience.
  • At least one year of supervisory/management experience.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • Strong knowledge of HR practices and Brazilian employment laws
  • Ability to influence and coach leaders at all levels
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable handling sensitive issues with professionalism and discretion
  • Strong analytical and project management capabilities
